characters.description: The young Dragon Rider bonded to the dragon Saphira, now trained by the elves and hardened by war. Committed to the Varden's fight against the Empire, he is also bound by a personal vow to rescue his cousin Roran's captured betrothed and to reckon with painful claims about his own family, all while carrying the hopes of the rebellion.
characters.name: Eragon

characters.description: Eragon's blue dragon and lifelong partner, powerful, proud, and sharp of mind. She flies and fights beside him, shares every thought and feeling, and holds firm views of her own, one of the last free dragons and central to any hope of breaking the king's grip on the land.
characters.name: Saphira

characters.description: Eragon's cousin, who led his whole village to safety and joined the Varden. Tough, clever, and driven, he has become a respected fighter among the rebels, but his overriding purpose is to free Katrina, the woman he loves, from the Empire's servants.
characters.name: Roran

characters.description: Roran's betrothed, taken captive by the king's servants and held in a dark stronghold. Her rescue is the urgent errand that opens the book and the anchor of Roran's every choice.
characters.name: Katrina

characters.description: The young, iron-willed leader of the Varden, holding together a coalition of humans, dwarves, and elves through politics, courage, and force of character. She commands Eragon's loyalty and must make hard, sometimes ruthless decisions to keep the rebellion alive and its allies united.
characters.name: Nasuada

characters.description: The elf envoy and warrior who works closely with the Varden. Reserved and highly capable in magic and combat, she accompanies Eragon on dangerous errands and remains a steady, guarded presence at the heart of the elves' involvement in the war.
characters.name: Arya

characters.description: Eragon's estranged counterpart, a Rider forced into the king's service and bound by oaths in the ancient language, riding the red dragon Thorn. Bitter and dangerous, he claims a shared parentage with Eragon and serves the Empire against his will, a captive weapon Eragon dreads meeting again in battle.
characters.name: Murtagh

characters.description: Eragon's dwarf friend of the ruling clan, loyal and forthright. With the dwarves' throne empty, he is drawn into the dangerous politics of his people, whose choices will matter greatly to the Varden's cause.
characters.name: Orik

characters.description: The elder elf Rider living in seclusion who trained Eragon, a survivor of the destroyed order. Learned and grave, he continues to guide Eragon in the disciplines of a Rider while carrying his own long burdens from the fall of the Riders.
characters.name: Oromis

characters.description: The great gold dragon bonded to Eragon's elven teacher, ancient and mighty, who helps school Saphira in the deep ways of dragons. Like his Rider, he is one of the last of the old order to survive the king's purge.
characters.name: Glaedr

characters.description: The tyrant king of the Empire, a renegade Rider of vast and growing power who rules through fear and controls his enslaved servants with unbreakable oaths. Unseen but ever-present, his strength and cruelty define the danger the Varden face.
characters.name: Galbatorix
